name: Kokoroid ~Denshi Kairo de Koi Shiteru~
original_name: ここロイド～電子回路で恋してる～
source:
One day, the main character receives "Doll", an android. On the other hand, he has a neighbor girl named Riho. You can choose to educate the android or build a relationship with the real girl.

There are three different endings.

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047416.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公收到名为‘Doll’的仿生人。另一方面，他还有一位名叫里穗的邻家女孩。玩家可以选择教育仿生人，或与现实中的女孩培养感情。

游戏共有3种不同结局。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047416.html]DLsite English[/url]]
